proposals.expected_signal: Small but reliable NDCG@10 lift if popularity-skewed propagation is overfitting; strongest signal should appear as better mid-tail ranking stability without changing full-sort protocol.
proposals.failure_mode: Contrastive auxiliary may collapse into popularity agreement and add no value, or degree-aware perturbation may oversmooth sparse users/items and slightly hurt top-rank precision.
proposals.hypothesis: Adding a lightweight self-supervised dual-view objective on top of LightGCN, where the two graph views are created by degree-aware edge thinning, will improve robustness of embeddings to noisy/high-degree interactions and recover generalization beyond pure pairwise ranking.
